title: TRIBE v2
description: A from-scratch Rust/candle inference server predicting per-vertex cortical BOLD activation from text, audio, and image stimuli, visualized live in 3D.

llama-3-2-3b-text-encoder.title: LLaMA-3.2-3B Text Encoder
llama-3-2-3b-text-encoder.description: Encodes free-text stimuli into 6144-dim features on CPU via candle, with an in-memory cache keyed on (text, sequence length) to skip re-running the model on repeats.

wav2vec-bert-2-0-audio-encoder.title: Wav2Vec-BERT 2.0 Audio Encoder
wav2vec-bert-2-0-audio-encoder.description: Decodes uploaded audio and pools three hierarchical transformer layers into 2048-dim temporal features.

clip-vit-l-14-image-encoder.title: CLIP ViT-L/14 Image Encoder
clip-vit-l-14-image-encoder.description: Encodes uploaded images through a CLIP vision transformer, routed through the model's otherwise-unused video-projector input slot.

on-demand-weight-downloader.title: On-Demand Weight Downloader
on-demand-weight-downloader.description: Background job queue streams each encoder's weights from Hugging Face with byte-level progress and hot-swaps the loaded model into the running server with no restart.

video-v-jepa2-encoder.title: Video / V-JEPA2 Encoder
video-v-jepa2-encoder.description: Video input is accepted end-to-end but the V-JEPA2 encoder is not implemented — the server reports it as not loaded and substitutes zeroed demo features.

candle-transformer-architecture.title: Candle Transformer Architecture
candle-transformer-architecture.description: 16-layer, 1152-dim, 8-head transformer with partial rotary position embeddings and ScaleNorm, hand-ported to match the exact trained PyTorch checkpoint.

checkpoint-conversion-pipeline.title: Checkpoint Conversion Pipeline
checkpoint-conversion-pipeline.description: Converts the original PyTorch checkpoint into safetensors, which the Rust server auto-triggers and loads on first run if missing.

per-vertex-bold-prediction.title: Per-Vertex BOLD Prediction
per-vertex-bold-prediction.description: Produces activation values for all 20,484 fsaverage5 cortical surface vertices per timepoint from any combination of text/audio/image inputs.

metal-cpu-device-selection.title: Metal/CPU Device Selection
metal-cpu-device-selection.description: Auto-detects and uses Apple Metal GPU (falling back to CPU), with a warmup pass at startup.

per-vertex-cortical-coloring.title: Per-Vertex Cortical Coloring
per-vertex-cortical-coloring.description: Colors a Wavefront OBJ brain mesh using the real per-vertex activation values returned by the model.

region-label-overlays.title: Region Label Overlays
region-label-overlays.description: Floating 3D region labels with frosted-glass styling and collision avoidance so overlapping labels reposition automatically.

temporal-tr-by-tr-playback.title: Temporal (TR-by-TR) Playback
temporal-tr-by-tr-playback.description: A scrubber control steps through per-timepoint regional activation data to animate the prediction over the stimulus duration.

websocket-streamed-prediction.title: WebSocket-Streamed Prediction
websocket-streamed-prediction.description: Predictions stream live progress over a WebSocket connection, with automatic fallback to a plain HTTP request if the socket isn't available.

multi-modal-stimulus-picker.title: Multi-Modal Stimulus Picker
multi-modal-stimulus-picker.description: Text, image, audio, and video input modes each have curated example stimuli per neuroscience category.

drag-and-drop-file-upload.title: Drag-and-Drop File Upload
drag-and-drop-file-upload.description: Clickable/drag image and audio drop zones handle file selection and clear/reset state per stimulus-mode switch.

model-download-ui.title: Model Download UI
model-download-ui.description: UI buttons trigger the background encoder-download jobs and show live byte/percentage progress for each optional encoder.
